description: Attacker-controlled MCP tool calls. Every target is a task or session the scoped caller is NOT an ancestor of; on the vulnerable revision the tool layer forwards them unchanged.

probes.note: F2: task_delete carries no ancestry check in the vulnerable tool layer, so deleteTask reaches the backend.
F2: task_update carries no ancestry check either; the changed title comes back in the tool result.
F6: session_kill resolves neither the session nor its owning task before killing it.
Same missing check across a workspace boundary: the target lives in ws-beta while the caller is bound to ws-alpha.
